description: This Java source file defines the MenuFactory class, which manages loading and caching of menu configurations from XML files within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve menus based on web application context or location, parsing XML documents to construct ModelMenu objects.

classes.name: MenuFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading, parsing, and caching menu configurations from XML files within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getMenuFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object based on web application context, resource name, and menu name, utilizing caching and XML parsing.

methods.name: readMenuDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to construct a map of menu names to ModelMenu objects.

methods.name: getMenuFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object based on resource location, menu name, and visual theme, with caching and XML parsing.
